content.title: Citi to turn to more minority investors after Banamex stake sale
content.summary: Citigroup will look for more minority investors in its Mexican retail unit, Banamex, before launching a potential initial public offering, executives said on Thursday.  Citi will sound out top Mexican investors in the coming months, though it will look to sell stakes much smaller than the 25% that billionaire Fernando Chico Pardo will buy, Ernesto Torres, Citi's head of international, told journalists.  The lender announced on Wednesday that Chico Pardo, who chairs airport operator ASUR, would purchase the sizeable stake in Banamex for $2.3 billion.
